constraints.description: European Postdoctoral Fellowships must have a standard duration of between 12 and 24 months.

Global Postdoctoral Fellowships require an outgoing phase of minimum 12 and maximum 24 months in a non-associated Third Country, plus a mandatory 12-month return phase to a host organisation based in an EU Member State or a Horizon Europe Associated Country.
Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic or non-academic sector.
Fellowships are provided to excellent researchers undertaking international mobility.

For European Postdoctoral Fellowships, secondments cannot exceed half of the requested duration of the action (excluding any additional period for a non-academic placement) and should be in line with the project objectives.
Secondments cannot take place during the mandatory twelve-month return period to the host organisation in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country (Global Fellowships).

Postdoctoral Fellowships can provide an additional period of up to six months for a placement at the end of the project in a non-academic sector organisation established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country. The request for this non-academic placement must be an integral part of the proposal, explaining added value, and is subject to evaluation.

If the non-academic placement does not meet the requirements (i.e. taking place in an academic organisation or in a Third Country), the proposal will be evaluated without taking the placement into account, which might affect the final score.

Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences common to all fields, including digital ones (e.g. generative AI), and foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, innovation and entrepreneurship where applicable, and good scientific conduct such as research integrity.

A Career Development Plan must be established jointly by the supervisor(s) and the researcher, covering research objectives and the researcher's training and career needs; it must be submitted as a project deliverable at the beginning of the action and updated when needed.
Admissibility conditions and proposal page limits/layout are described in Annex A and Annex E of the Work Programme General Annexes and Part B of the Application Form in the Submission System.

Specific eligibility conditions apply to MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships in the research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme; for such proposals a non-academic placement host must be established in an EU Member State or a country associated to the Euratom Research and Training Programme.
